Free Agency 2026 — Who’s Still on the Market and Where They Stand Real Madrid have published their starting lineup for the upcoming match against Bayern Munich in the return leg of the Champions League Quarterfinals. Los Blancos need to overcome the 1-2 deficit after losing the first leg at the Santiago Bernabeu, so converting the opportunities they’ll get will be massive tonight if they want to get a ticket to the Champions League Semifinals. STARTING LINEUPS Real Madrid starting XI: Lunin; Trent, Militao, Rüdiger, Mendy; Fede, Bellingham, Güler; Brahim, Vinicius, Mbappé Bayern Munich starting XI (TBC): Neuer, Laimer, Tah, Upamecano, Stanisic, Pavlovic, Kimmich, Olise, Gnabry, Diaz, Kane. HOW TO WATCH, STREAM CHAMPIONS LEAGUE Date: 04/15/2025 Time: 21:00 CET, 03:00pm EST. Venue: Allianz Arena, Munich, Germany.
